purpose: Repository audit record for the declared connectome teaching demo; not page copy.

verdict.scope: Declared population-rate model and teacher. No biological learning claim, general intelligence claim, uniform-random policy comparison, or proof of long-run stability.
Declared population-rate model and teacher. No biological learning claim, general intelligence claim, uniform-random policy comparison, or proof of long-run stability.

controls_and_assessment.matched_control: Identical starting gain, weights, seed, body/pilot and schedule; only plasticity frozen. Subsequent actions may differ through gaze feedback.
controls_and_assessment.assessment: Both halves, two pulse amplitudes, 12- and 24-second unclipped motor readouts from separate fresh copies of the acquired weights. Probes never alter the continuing life.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Learning-off restored a higher gain; reset did not reliably reset learned relations.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Separate freeze/resume, explicit fresh learner and compiled baseline operations; matched gain control.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The first half cleared references before the second half decided whether to learn; unfinished fixations could cross feedback conditions.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Both decisions read one reference snapshot; condition switches discard pending teaching evidence.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Early stopping gave free and nudged one-sided phases different elapsed durations.
findings_and_repairs.repair: The free continuation uses exactly the nudged phase actual step count.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Global relative scaling depended on disconnected contacts and did not bound individual proposals.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Normalize each contact proposal by its own endpoint products; retain local receiving-row input-mass and sign constraints.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Training-derived hold estimates and discarded growing responses hid unstable motor readouts.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Independent fresh-state weight-copy probes record actual readout retention, including growth; retain all failures.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A 100% reference target with a 5% dead zone permitted slow growth after reteaching.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Use the existing target-fraction gene at 0.95. In integrator reference units the nominal no-update band becomes 90–100%, rather than 95–105%; this motivates the change but is not a stability proof.

protocol_changes: Select contact-local proposal scaling with eta 0.01 after development comparisons; no extra learner or optimizer was added.
The fixed 420-second initial lesson failed the unchanged minimum-retention gate in two halves. Increase fixed exposure to 600 seconds; preserve the failure.
Direct return-to-hold reteaching exposed growth at target fraction 1. Preserve that failure, select target fraction 0.95 on development seeds, then freeze source and gates before seeds 10–12.
preserved_records: receipts/learning_audit/before_audit/receipt.json and its complete runnable source closure
The original receipts/learning.json and historical library parity fixtures were not rewritten.
manifesto_alignment: Retain the existing sparse population brain, anatomy payload and free/nudged local contrast. No additional prediction network, policy optimizer, global corrective controller or new brain module.
Replace a nonlocal normalization with endpoint-local information; tune existing step-size and target-fraction genes rather than adding mechanisms.

Preserve earlier evidence, disclose failures and use matched controls with independent behavior assessment. This remains the declared population-solver demonstration, not evidence that an integrated Brain.compose learner has been validated.
limits: Three seeded lives are not three independent anatomical reconstructions or biological experiments.
The teacher uses saved integrator activity, not measured retinal slip or rendered visual input; swimming and saccade scheduling include a declared application pilot.
Passing these finite pulse tests does not establish asymptotic stability, a continuum of stationary memories, spiking-learning equivalence or unlimited repeatability.
Amplified feedback remains an experimental condition; no reliable oscillation or universal recovery claim follows.
The evidence compares plastic and frozen circuits, not learned policy intelligence or a uniform-random policy benchmark.
The browser must also pass its interaction and regression checks; these receipts certify the headless protocols they name.
